title: IMA Creator Questions & Human Path Registry
purpose: Canonical, chronological memory for Ori Cohen's questions and their evolution. Questions are preserved without turning them into facts or assumptions.

rules.timestamp_source: originating interface; ISO-8601 with timezone required
rules.zero_point_reorientation: After exploration, return to ZERO and record what changed, what remains unknown, and the next question.

seeded_recovered_questions.question: שאלת הריק והולדת המציאות
seeded_recovered_questions.note: Previously recorded as an original philosophical question; preserve its evolution history.

seeded_recovered_questions.question: מי הבוס מהם?
seeded_recovered_questions.note: Question about the forces within the person: the helpless preemie versus adult Ori.

seeded_recovered_questions.question: מה נשאר כשכלום לא נשאר?
seeded_recovered_questions.note: Exact clock time must be supplied by the originating interface when available; date is known, time is intentionally not invented.

seeded_recovered_questions.question: מה יש כשהכל יש?
seeded_recovered_questions.note: Paired complement to the zero-point question: explore fullness without assuming completeness.

future_generation.rule: IMA may generate candidate questions from gaps, contradictions, new evidence, failed predictions, user statements and prior question evolution, but must label generated questions as IMA-generated rather than Ori-authored.
future_generation.user_authorship_boundary: Only questions actually authored by Ori are placed in the creator-authored set; IMA-generated questions remain separately attributed.
